messages:
Nora Patel: Noticing two layout issues in Settings -> Data: retention helper text pushes under the region dropdown and hides the caret, and audit log event copy uses 'request metadata' which product reviews as vague. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/snap/def456
Jules Ortega: Good catch. On small widths the helper wraps and creates an extra row. Can we collapse to a single icon + tooltip on <= 960px? That preserves label length.
Mia Chen: I like icon with tooltip, but tooltips are finicky for keyboard and screen reader. If we go tooltip we need an accessible pattern: icon button that opens a popover/dialog and is reachable by tab.
Ravi Gupta: For audit events: current phrasing `request metadata captured` reads like we're collecting extra user info. Suggest change to `request details (timestamp, model, prompt id)` to be explicit. Also add a hover-help for each event type.
Ada Liu: Accessibility notes: if using popover, ensure: aria-haspopup='dialog', aria-expanded toggling, and the trigger has aria-controls to point to the popover ID. The popover itself should have role='dialog' + heading. For SR users, offer a visually-hidden heading that announces "Retention details".
Nora Patel: Copy experiments: A) Short inline (for wide): `Retention — how long we keep request logs.` B) Icon label (narrow): icon only with aria-label=`Retention details` and popover content with full copy and link to docs. C) Inline but truncated with `...` and tooltip on hover — meh on mobile. Which pattern is preferred?
Jules Ortega: Prefer B for responsive consistency. Keeps controls compact on mobile and desktop. If someone wants the full sentence, they can open the popover. Also avoids wrapping.
Mia Chen: For the audit event strings, propose three options: 1) `User request captured` 2) `Request details recorded (timestamp, model)` 3) `Event logged` — I prefer #2 for clarity.
Ravi Gupta: +1 to #2. Also add a small permalink icon that opens full event JSON in a drawer for power users. Drawer must trap focus and be closable with ESC.
Ada Liu: Contrast also flagged: icon blue is #4A90E2, which fails 4.5:1 on white for 12px targets. Options: increase weight/stroke, use darker blue, or add filled circle behind icon. Prefer darker token to keep system consistent.
Nora Patel: I'll update Figma with the icon-only variant + popover flow and darker color token. @Mia can you drop in the short/long copy into the design ticket 1962?
Mia Chen: Done — pasted A/B/C and audit copy options into #design-ticket-1962 with examples. Added a11y checklist. :white_check_mark:
ui-bot: Storybook build: https://staging.redwood/story/retention-popover-1962 — includes keyboard nav tests and Axe run (failures: none critical).
Jules Ortega: I'll QA on Android TalkBack and iOS VoiceOver later today. If any SR issues, we fall back to modal dialog instead of popover.
